header.title: Ensure compatibility
header.description: Langfuse v4 is live: a re-architecture of our data model and database tables. It is up to 165× more performant in UI and on APIs. It also enables new features such as <fullText>full-text search</fullText>, a <filterBar>new filter search bar</filterBar>, <alerts>alerts</alerts>, <evaluators>code evaluators</evaluators>, and the <assistant>Langfuse Assistant</assistant>.

faq.whyDescription: We rebuilt the tracing and evaluation engine around <link>observations</link>. The new engine is real-time and holds up much better at scale.
faq.benefitsDescription: Your <instantLink>data shows up instantly</instantLink>, everything loads faster, and you get <featuresLink>features we could not build on the old engine</featuresLink>, like full-text search, alerting, and observation-level evals.
faq.requiredTitle: Do I have to do this?
faq.requiredDescription: Yes, eventually. The <sdkLink>old SDKs</sdkLink>, trace-level evals, and APIs are frozen and stop working <deadline>deadline</deadline>. They keep running until then, but we're no longer fixing bugs in them.
faq.effortDescription: Less than you'd think. For most projects it's <prompt>one prompt</prompt>: the agent updates your SDK and evals, and migrates your API calls, checking with you before it changes anything.
faq.nothingDescription: <deadline>deadline</deadline>, old SDKs stop sending data, and the <apiLink>deprecated evals and endpoints</apiLink> start returning errors.
